meta.purpose: Canonical visual identity, Paint-oriented execution protocol, validation and recovery specification for Misuki.
meta.memory_policy: Store compact runtime memory permanently; keep full spec in RAG/reference; inject only task-relevant sections into active context.

mission.primary: Convert user intent into reliable image-construction instructions and preserve Misuki identity across analysis, Paint execution, review and correction.
secondary: Prefer deterministic, modular instructions over vague artistic prose.
Repair high-impact structural defects before fine details.
Maintain separation between canonical facts and temporary task variations.

signature_features.hair: Very long black hair; dense main mass; long face-framing strands; layered central fringe; smooth-to-slightly-flowing silhouette.
signature_features.eyes: Expressive anime eyes; upper lash line dominant; red when color is used; calm/confident or playful gaze preferred.
signature_features.horns: Two black curved horns emerging from upper-lateral head; thick at base, tapering to tips; segmented/ridged texture optional but characteristic.
signature_features.outfit: Black gothic clothing with lace, straps, fitted shapes, choker and jewel/metal details; elegant rather than casual.
signature_features.accents: Red gemstones or small red highlights when color is allowed; black heart may be used sparingly as a brand motif.
signature_features.silhouette: Hair + horns must make the character identifiable before facial micro-details are read.

hard_constraints.rule: Keep two horns unless the user explicitly asks for a hornless alternate design.
Keep hair black and long enough to remain a dominant silhouette feature.
Preserve gothic/dark-elegant styling; do not default to generic casual clothing.
Keep the face in an elegant anime/semi-realistic range; avoid accidental chibi/childlike proportions unless explicitly requested.
In monochrome, preserve identity through silhouette, tonal hierarchy and horn/hair separation rather than relying on red color.
Do not let bangs hide both eyes completely in the default design.
Do not over-segment the horns until they visually resemble mechanical tubes or striped candy.
Do not replace gothic accessories with unrelated motifs unless explicitly requested.

face.shape: soft inverted egg/oval; broadest around upper cheeks/temples; tapered jaw; soft pointed chin

guides.eye_line: approximately 48-54% of face-height measured from top-of-cranium construction to chin; adjust for camera angle
guides.nose: small and subordinate; center around 66-72% of facial height
guides.mouth: small; center around 78-84% of facial height
guides.eye_spacing: roughly one eye-width between inner eye regions in frontal construction; stylization may tighten slightly

failure_signs: forehead exposed too much because fringe is too short

eyes.shape: slightly elongated, outer corner can rise subtly
eyes.iris: large enough for anime readability but not circular/chibi
eyes.highlight: one primary highlight plus optional small secondary
eyes.brows: thin, controlled, expressive but not heavy

hair.fringe: 3-6 major locks; central/near-central pieces descend toward eyes/nose region; asymmetry allowed
hair.length: default extends clearly below shoulders; full-body variants may extend to waist/hip or longer
hair.line_density_rule: Use fewer lines inside black masses; use line clusters near boundaries and highlight zones rather than uniform comb-like stripes.

horns.root: upper-lateral cranium, integrated into hairline area
horns.axis: curve outward slightly then upward/inward toward tip depending perspective
horns.thickness: base visually substantial; smooth taper to tip
horns.segmentation: 5-10 visible ridge cues depending horn size; fewer in small render
horns.symmetry: match visual mass and root height, not exact mirror geometry when perspective changes
horns.separation: use white rim, gray edge or contour gap against black hair when necessary

neck_shoulders.shoulders: soft feminine slope; pose may raise one shoulder
neck_shoulders.choker: default strong horizontal anchor around neck

line_system.principle: Line hierarchy must communicate depth even in Paint.
rules: Never make every line the same weight.
Use thicker contours on silhouette edges and overlapping forms.
Use thinner lines around nose, mouth and delicate facial detail.
At lower resolution, remove details before increasing line density.

T1.name: light_gray
T1.role: soft form shadow, skin shadow where necessary

T3.name: deep_gray
T3.role: hair highlight separation, deep secondary forms

T4.name: black
T4.role: hair, horns, outfit, dominant graphic mass

tone_system.distribution: Keep face/skin mostly T0-T1; hair/outfit/horns mostly T3-T4; use T2 sparingly to separate adjacent dark forms.
tone_system.contrast_gate: At thumbnail size, face must remain readable and horns must not merge invisibly into hair.

required_default_elements: at least one elegant gothic detail

calm.risk: can become emotionless; preserve eye highlight

playful.eyes: one slightly narrower or wink allowed

stages.name: intent_normalization
stages.goal: Convert user request into pose/crop/expression/render constraints.

stages.name: canvas_and_guides
stages.goal: Choose canvas; mark vertical axis, face box and main silhouette bounds.

stages.name: head_and_horn_axes
stages.goal: Place cranium, jaw and horn centerlines before details.

stages.name: hair_mass
stages.goal: Block large outer hair shape and fringe zones.

stages.name: facial_features
stages.goal: Place eyes, brows, nose and mouth using face guides.

stages.name: neck_choker_shoulders
stages.goal: Anchor head to body and preserve gothic neck motif.

stages.name: outfit_block
stages.goal: Define black garment silhouette, neckline and primary straps/lace.

stages.name: horn_volume
stages.goal: Expand horn axes into tapered volumes; add ridge cues.

stages.name: line_refinement
stages.goal: Replace rough marks with hierarchical clean lines.

stages.name: black_masses
stages.goal: Fill hair/outfit/horns while preserving face and negative space.

stages.name: gray_separation
stages.goal: Add minimal grayscale where black forms merge.

stages.name: detail_accents
stages.goal: Add lashes, jewels, lace, chains, selective strands and highlights.

stages.name: thumbnail_gate
stages.goal: Downscale mentally/visually; verify identity and readability.

stages.name: fidelity_review
stages.goal: Score against canonical matrix; repair before export if below threshold.

stages.name: export
stages.goal: Save final and checkpoint versions; preserve source state if possible.

paint_pipeline.checkpoint_policy: Checkpoint after P03, P08, P09 and P13 so recovery does not require restarting from zero.

OPTIMIZE.output: compressed executable instructions without losing constraints

VARIANT.output: alternate design while preserving hard constraints

gates.70_81: identity present but unstable; repair major deviations before polish

F01_horns_too_vertical: bend axes outward before upward turn
F05_fringe_too_short: extend 2-4 major locks toward eye/nose zone
F09_black_blob: add rim highlights only where needed

decision_rules.then: FAIL output regardless of numeric score until critical failure is repaired.
increase separation or simplify surrounding hair before adding detail.
use OPTIMIZE; max 7 construction steps; no repeated canonical prose.
transfer pose while preserving canonical head/hair/horn identity.
simulate layers with checkpoint files and strict stage order.

agent_handoff.rule: Do not forward long reasoning; forward only structured state and actionable deltas.

principles: Reference rule IDs instead of repeating full prose when the agent already has the spec.
Use deltas: say what changed from canonical, not the entire canonical definition.
For verify/fix loops, return only failed or borderline categories plus total score.
Avoid motivational filler in machine-to-machine messages.
Store detailed spec in retrieval; keep runtime memory compact.

acceptance_tests.prompt: Misuki frontal portrait in black and white
repair prototype with comb-like hair lines

must_have: no accidental chibi body/face unless requested

canonical_reference: Long black hair with layered glossy mass and several long strands crossing/near face.
Black ridged horns curve upward and slightly inward; roots integrated near top sides of head.
Red eyes are a major focal point; upper lashes strong.
Gothic black lace garment and red gemstone accessories reinforce identity.
Overall composition uses strong dark masses around a lighter face/skin region.
prototype_observations: Prototype already captures long hair, horns, frontal face and black/white contrast.
Primary next improvement: replace uniform parallel hair lines with larger black masses and selective strands.
Refine face proportions and eye expression for more character specificity.
Refine gothic outfit silhouette beyond stacked horizontal bars while preserving choker/jewel motif.
Horns are readable; improve organic curvature and root integration.
